blurb_en:
Anthropic marked its new flagship down by half before it even launched — Opus 5, released Thursday, costs the same as Opus 4.8 and half what the company charges for Fable 5, while beating the more expensive model on eight of thirteen standard benchmarks.
• FrontierBench v0.1: Opus 5 scores 43.3% versus Fable 5's 33.7%.
• ARC-AGI 3: three times the score of the next-best model.
• CursorBench 3.2: within 0.5% of Fable 5's peak at roughly half the per-task cost.
• Fastest knowledge cutoff of any Claude model: May 2026.
• Four Claude models in two months: Anthropic is either very productive or very focused on not being left behind.
• Fable 5 launched in June at $10 and $50 per million tokens and lasted less than seven weeks as the company's undisputed best model.
• The company built a model that makes its most expensive option look overpriced. This was either the plan or a very good accident.
blurb_zh:
Anthropic 于周四发布 Claude Opus 5，定价每百万 token 输入 5 美元、输出 25 美元——与 Opus 4.8 持平，仅为 Fable 5 价格的一半，同时在 13 项标准基准测试中的 8 项上超越了这款更贵的旗舰模型。
• FrontierBench v0.1：Opus 5 得分 43.3%，Fable 5 为 33.7%。
• ARC-AGI 3：Opus 5 得分为第二名的三倍。
• CursorBench 3.2：以约一半的单任务成本，达到 Fable 5 峰值的 0.5% 以内。
• 知识截止日期为 2026 年 5 月，是所有 Claude 模型中最新的。
• 两个月内四款新 Claude 模型：Anthropic 要么效率极高，要么压力极大。
• Fable 5 于 6 月上线，定价每百万 token 输入 10 美元、输出 50 美元，不到七周便被自家新品超越。
• Anthropic 造出了一款让自家旗舰显得溢价的新模型。这是否在计划之中，不得而知。
verification_notes: Confirmed via SiliconAngle (July 24), The Next Web (July 24, 'fourth model in two months, tops Fable 5 on most benchmarks'), DigitalApplied (July 24), tech-ish (July 24), BigGo Finance. Pricing $5/$25 per MTok, FrontierBench 43.3% vs Fable 5's 33.7%, ARC-AGI 3x next-best, CursorBench within 0.5% at half cost, May 2026 knowledge cutoff, 1M-token context window all consistent across sources. Anthropic.com returned 403.

blurb_en:
Midjourney released V8.2 as the default model on July 24, ending a month-long preview period, with the update centered on aesthetics, boldness, and a significantly more capable version of its Personalization system.
• V8.2 images are described by Midjourney as more creative, bold, sophisticated, and edgy — with a notable reduction in the rate of low-quality outputs.
• The bigger change: Personalization now understands your aesthetic much better, particularly on profiles with many ratings. The pool of images used to build new Personalization profiles has also expanded.
• V8.2 has been accessible since June 25 via the --preview flag; it is now default with no flag required.
• Midjourney has shipped four model updates since January 2026, all without a public app, an IPO, or a CEO who speaks to press.
• This newsletter has been searching for V8.2 for 38 consecutive runs. The streak is over.
• For creative teams at Insta360 using Midjourney for visual concepts, reference art, or campaign imagery: the Personalization improvements mean the model now generates closer to your specific aesthetic, not a statistical average.
• It was in preview for a month. Now it's the default. Midjourney does not ask.
blurb_zh:
Midjourney 于 7 月 24 日将 V8.2 设为默认版本，结束了长达一个月的预览期，此次更新聚焦于美感表现、大胆风格与个性化匹配能力的全面提升。
• 官方描述 V8.2 生成的图像"更有创意、更大胆、更精致、更有棱角"，低质量输出率显著降低。
• 最大变化在于个性化：系统对用户审美偏好的理解大幅提升，评分数据越多效果越明显；V8.2 个性化档案可用的图像池也已扩充。
• V8.2 自 6 月 25 日起可通过 --preview 参数使用，现已无需参数直接成为默认版本。
• 2026 年以来，Midjourney 已推出四次版本更新，全程无公开 App、无 IPO、无公开发言的 CEO。
• 本通讯连续 38 期搜索 V8.2，漫长等待终于结束。
• 对于 Insta360 使用 Midjourney 进行概念设计或活动视觉的创意团队：个性化升级意味着生成结果越来越贴近你的风格，而非所有用户的平均水平。
• 预览了一个月的版本，就这样成了你无法选择退出的默认选项。Midjourney 就是这么更新的。
verification_notes: Confirmed via official Midjourney changelog at updates.midjourney.com/version-8-2/ (primary), Midjourney docs at docs.midjourney.com (July 24 default date), David Bates/Enthusiastically Midjourney Medium (July 2026), Christie C./Medium (July 2026), kie.ai blog. All consistent: July 24 default release, aesthetic/boldness/personalization focus, --preview available since June 25.

blurb_en:
Jack Dorsey's Block launched Buzz on July 21, an open-source workplace platform where AI agents receive their own accounts, cryptographic keys, and team memberships — not plugins or add-ons, but listed colleagues.
• Each agent gets a full Buzz account with its own identity and permissions, built on the Nostr decentralized protocol. At the platform level, there is no technical distinction between a human and an AI team member.
• Buzz combines group chat, project tracking, and code repository functions in one surface, positioning it against both Slack and GitHub simultaneously.
• The desktop app is free and available now on macOS, Windows, and Linux. Apache 2.0 license on GitHub. Mobile apps, approval gates, and voice features are still coming.
• Dorsey described it as "model-agnostic, decentralized, self-sovereign and open source" — four things he considers selling points.
• For teams at Insta360 thinking about agentic workflows: Buzz anticipates what happens when AI agents become accountable contributors rather than utilities — their own Git history, their own message thread, their own blame in the commit log.
• The man who invented the 140-character public post is back to building communication tools. At least this one doesn't have a character limit.
blurb_zh:
Dorsey 旗下支付公司 Block 于 7 月 21 日发布 Buzz——一个开源职场协作平台，AI 智能体在此拥有独立账户、加密密钥和团队成员身份，不是插件，是同事。
• 每个智能体在 Buzz 上拥有完整账户与独立权限，基于去中心化 Nostr 协议构建。平台层面，AI 与人类成员没有技术区别。
• Buzz 将群组消息、项目管理与代码仓库功能整合于一体，同时瞄准 Slack 和 GitHub 两个市场。
• 桌面端应用已上线，macOS、Windows、Linux 均可免费使用，代码在 GitHub 以 Apache 2.0 协议开源。移动端及语音功能仍在开发中。
• Dorsey 称其"与模型无关、去中心化、自主可控、完全开源"——他将这四点列为卖点。
• 对 Insta360 考虑引入智能体工作流的团队：Buzz 的架构预判了一个近未来——AI 智能体像正式员工一样提交代码、留下记录、被追责。
• 发明了 140 字公开帖的人回来做通讯工具了。好消息是：Buzz 没有字数限制。
verification_notes: Confirmed via TechCrunch (July 21, primary), Slashdot (July 22), SmartCompany.au, Cryptopolitan, WinBuzzer (July 24), AndroidHeadlines. Nostr protocol, Apache 2.0 license, desktop app availability, 'model-agnostic decentralized' description, features list all consistent across sources.
